planets.name: WASP-107 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-107 with a 5.72-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: WASP-107 b was found in 2017 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around WASP-107. Its orbit and size follow Yee & Vissapragada 2026's fit, the archive's default.
